description: This file implements a WebRTC-based local media recorder that captures video frames, encodes them, and writes them into a WebM container. It defines classes for managing video encoding, frame handling, and file output, with integration to WebRTC APIs.

classes.name: LocalRecorder::Display
classes.description: Handles video frame encoding, callback processing, and thread management for encoding video frames and writing encoded data to the WebM file.

classes.name: LocalRecorder::Impl
classes.description: Holds the core components for file writing, segment management, and encoder factory, serving as the implementation detail for the LocalRecorder.

methods.name: LocalRecorder::Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a LocalRecorder instance with a specified filename.

methods.name: LocalRecorder::AddDisplay
methods.description: Adds a new video display source, sets up encoding, and starts the encoding thread.

methods.name: LocalRecorder::Stop
methods.description: Stops all displays, finalizes the segment, and closes the recording.

methods.name: LocalRecorder::Display::OnFrame
methods.description: Receives a video frame and queues it for encoding.

methods.name: LocalRecorder::Display::EncoderLoop
methods.description: Main loop for encoding queued frames and managing keyframes.

methods.name: LocalRecorder::Display::Stop
methods.description: Stops the encoding thread and removes the sink.

methods.name: LocalRecorder::Display::OnEncodedImage
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame has been encoded; writes the encoded frame to the WebM segment.
